entities.summary: Martin D. Hardin was a politician and lawyer from Kentucky. Born in Pennsylvania, his family migrated to Kentucky when he was still young. He studied law under George Nicholas and commenced practice at Richmond, Kentucky. His cousin, future U.S. Representative Benjamin Hardin, studied in his law office. He represented Madison County in the Kentucky House of Representatives for a single term.
